review_notes: This is a face-level seven-section topology review, not a printable solid.
Glow panels and mouth-opening facets are excluded from structural sections.

The rear-facing MANQ006/MANQ007 surfaces are split on the centerline and integrated into the lower-face shells; a compact separate rear-base frame follows the upper-head rear plane around the upper rear opening.
The large bottom MANQ008 facet is subdivided on the centerline and integrated into the right and left lower-face shells.
The two opaque panels adjacent to the corrected eyes and the two center-split bottom halves are surface islands; internal frame ribs will make them integral with their lower shells.
Printer-fit checks use a 15-degree orientation search and require later slicer confirmation after walls and flanges exist.
